svg.title: Coffee range: widen the local hue arc without losing the shared family
svg.desc: Only House and Night surface fills change. The hue span widens from HSL34/35/36 to15/35/55 while the central blend color remains fixed. Approximate relative luminance and saturation remain stable. Three shades remain three. All names, tasting notes, weights, prices and photographs stay fixed. Fictional example. Generated photographs reused unchanged. Typography and graphics composed separately.
svg.text: BEFORE · Variants nearly repeat one hue
AFTER · Related hues allow more variation
Only declared colors change. Copy, typography, geometry, imagery and photographic presentation stay fixed.
